The user feedback are indicated here (PDF file)
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1eyqu29L5d9czInsv5BEO1LHJJSbdxAny/view?usp=sharing
Some of the comments overlap with the feedback from M4, but they can be broadly divided into four categories:
 
・Requests for clarification of NFT functions and peripheral functions
・Frequency of updates regarding the latest information, including match results
・Support for players and the addition of information about players
・Related to design
 
 Of these, the feedback confirmed in M4 has been improved, and the frequency of news has been increased. Due to factors such as Apple's revenue structure, there are some issues that cannot be addressed or that would require significant development costs. Although these issues reduce user satisfaction, many of them are not fatal problems.
